limitations: One fresh execution; stable pair selection does not establish bit-identical weights across runs or toolchains.

Raw frozen gap metrics are historical fixed-query diagnostics: sozzled/starved/kitchen/umbrella now have dictionary coverage.
Actual candidate lookup comparisons use the isolated Model2Vec adapter. Any package-reader reference result is recorded separately and does not establish lookup parity or a shipping decision.
The eighteen fixed queries are a bounded diagnostic and not comprehensive linguistic fidelity.
